column4: DR's OPEN pushes one title-length byte and six option words, then passes the file's control-block address in HL to ?OIOOP. Titleless: 21 bytes, option word 0690H = 0x0400 declared-file + 0x0200 stream organisation + 0x0010 stream + 0x0080 input, words 2..6 built from the zero in B (MOV H,B / MOV L,B). With a literal-string TITLE: 29 bytes -- XRA A becomes LXI H,<pool bytes>; MVI A,<byte length>; CALL ?SLCTS (net +7), 0690H becomes 0E90H (the TITLE bit 0x0800) and w2 becomes LXI H,0000H because B now holds the title length (net +1). `input' and `stream' set the same bits, so either spelling lowers identically. An OPEN naming NO mode DEFAULTS TO INPUT and measures the same 0x0690: E46E4 `open file(f);' and E46G3 `open file(f) stream;' are both 0x0690 and E46G1 `open file(f) title(...)';' is 0x0E90, so the title bit composes with the default exactly as with a spelled mode [C286]. DR diagnoses a REPEATED option keyword, or two members of the exclusive mode group, as pass-2 CONFLICT and emits no .REL [C285].

column4: A PRINT open pushes w1 = 0x0652 titleless / 0x0E52 titled: bit 0x0002 sits on the output-side base 0x0650 and the 0x0200 stream-organisation bit is KEPT, so PRINT is NOT the spelled OUTPUT open; a title adds 0x0800 exactly as on every other measured route.  The STREAM keyword is BYTE-INVISIBLE on this route -- E52TD (stream print) and E52TI/TJ (bare print) share the prologue and the 0x2652 word, and E52TB equals DEPREC:51 (which spells stream) byte for byte at 0x2E52.  PAGESIZE/LINESIZE set attribute bits 0x2000/0x1000 by OPTION PRESENCE, independently of the parameter word they emit: pagesize(0) costs a bit plus a plain ZERO word and NO extra byte (E52TB = LOAN2:54).  The six pushed words follow a register-reuse LADDER on HL: after LXI H,w1 / PUSH H the first zero is LXI H,0000 with a title (B holds the title length) or MOV H,B + MOV L,B titleless (B = 0 from the XRA A / MOV B,A prologue); further zeros are bare PUSH H; a literal <=0xFF is MVI L,v (legal because H is already 0) and leaves L dirty so the next zero costs ONE byte -- MOV L,B titleless (E52TD) or MOV L,H titled (E52TG, H stayed 0); a literal >0xFF (LXI H,v, E52TJ pagesize(300)) or a variable (LHLD cell + DATA relocation, E52TI/E52TF = COPYLPT:38) clobbers both halves so the next zero re-materialises from B (MOV H,B / MOV L,B, measured titleless ONLY).  LINESIZE alone on a titled stream OUTPUT open is w1 = 0x1E50 with the literal in w6 (E52TE = KEYFILE:19).

column4: A named-file PUT attaches with DE = 0x0652 and CALL ?SIOOP after LXI H over the file's control block, and the ITEM chain is the console chain UNCHANGED.  The attach word and the two literal classes are what this row's four objects measure: E16D/E17D for `list(<character literal>)' and `list(<integer literal>)', E46L5 and E46L16 for the same literal chain living alongside a VARIABLE item in one DATA image.  The measured relation between the two mode words is one bit: 0x0252 + 0x0400 (declared file) = 0x0652, as 0x0290 + 0x0400 = 0x0690 for the GET.  0x0652 is NOT 0x0400|0x0200|0x0010|0x0040 (that is 0x0650): the attach also carries 0x0002, whose PRINT reading in P0 section 3 belongs to OPEN words, and which no GET attach has (the 3 record-WRITE attaches read 0x0650 = 0x0652 minus exactly that bit) -- so within ATTACH words 0x0002 separates put list from write and from get; what is measured is that pairing, not the bit's meaning, which is why this is one lowering with a parameter and not a second copy of PUT.  A numeric literal does NOT go the fixed-variable route: `list(42)' is ?DLDOP at the digit count, ?QDCOP at digits+3 with scale 0, then ?PNVOP, and its packed cell is allocated through the same image-dedup table as every other DEC pool cell [C280].  The FOUR VARIABLE CLASSES are the next row's, and [C293] is the claim that the two rows share one generator.  [E2E-52/P3-11] E52XG panel-verifies the P019B 26-B LIST block behind a lowered PRINT open (CODE 003E, DATA 0003): the 12-byte attach with DE = 0x0652 rides unchanged and the item chain (?SLCTS@002D, ?PNCOP@0030, ?QIOOP@0033) is the console chain UNCHANGED -- no statement byte was added or changed.

column4: The named-file route takes the SAME item chain the console route takes for the same variable, byte for byte including the resolved operand address, and differs only in the stream-selection prologue (`LXI H,<fcb> / LXI D,0652 / LXI B,<stmt> / CALL ?SIOOP' against `LXI D,0252 / LXI B,<stmt> / CALL ?SYSPR'), both ending in `CALL ?QIOOP'.  Four classes are authorized, each by its own whole byte-exact object: CHARACTER VARYING `LXI H,*D,<v> / ?SLVTS / ?PNCOP' (E46L1 -- the cell ADDRESS, not the 2-word `LHLD' descriptor form ?Vrop uses on the GET side, which is what my own P1e design note wrongly predicted); CHARACTER FIXED `LXI H,*D,<v> / MVI A,<declared length> / ?SLCTS / ?PNCOP' (E46L2, width inline from the declaration, not from the cell); FIXED BINARY `LHLD <k> / MVI A,09 / ?QICOP / ?PNVOP' (E46L3, 2-word VALUE operand); FIXED DECIMAL `LXI H,*D,<z> / MVI A,p / ?DLDOP / MVI A,p+3 / MVI B,s / ?QDCOP / ?PNVOP' (E46L4, p+3 = 9 with p = 6, s = 0 AND s = 3 in one object).  The operand form is chosen by STORAGE CLASS and not by route -- [C291]'s console rule, generalised.  Authorization is a SEPARATE decision from lowering: `authorize_file_item' runs before the open guard and before a byte is emitted, so a refusal names the operand it refused.  The attach word comes from a lowered OUTPUT open and nothing else, keyed on the FILE operand rather than on the title's spelling, so a VARIABLE title composes with this route unchanged (E46L6 [C294]).  At runtime the FILE route's content is NOT the console's: DR's runtime apostrophe-QUOTES every character item on a stream file and NOT on the console, separates items with ONE BLANK, never line-terminates, pads an under-filled CHARACTER FIXED with BLANKS to the declared length, honours a varying item's length byte without padding, and prints FIXED BINARY in DECIMAL -- all measured on DR's own written files, and none of it emitted by this compiler [C295].

A `^' over a GENERAL condition inverts that compare's own skip byte C2 (JNZ) -> CA (JZ) at E48A13 @000F -- value position is a DIFFERENT mechanism ([C310]'s `ADI FF / SBB A' tail), which is why the two must never be conflated.

column4: Every measured condition store ends `<materialiser> / <flag arithmetic> / 32 <cell>' (STA with an inline DATA reloc, [C079]). column4: A CALL target never consults a keyword or built-in table: calling an internal procedure whose name collides with a compiler built-in word yields CODE and DATA segments BYTE-IDENTICAL to the same program under a non-colliding name (all whole-file differences confined to the three packed program-name records PROG-NAME/EXTDEF/DEF-PUBLIC; E520B vs E520A = EXACTLY 3 differing bytes at 0-based 6/19/28). An arity-0 call written with EMPTY PARENS is the bare 3-byte CD 00 00 with NO descriptor cell, NO LXI H and DEF-DATA-SIZE unchanged; its operand word IS the chain slot. With two sites the CHAIN-ADDR record rides the LAST site's operand word, that word holds an inline code RELOC to the PREVIOUS site's operand word, the first word is the 00 00 terminator, and the linker fills the entry LC at the record's emission point into EVERY slot (E520C head 0026 -> 0007, entry 0047; authentic LOAN2 head 066F -> 0621, both filled 0733). A shadowed arity-1 call with a variable actual keeps the [C093] STATIC own-cell descriptor (SET-LC data@2 + RELOC -> data@0000, zero runtime code) and the [C094] peeled copy prologue 5E 23 56 EB / SHLD <formal cell> verbatim.

column4: A 1-D array of non-2-byte elements is contiguous element_size bytes per cell: stride 1 emits NO multiply in either bias form (LB-1 ladder LXI H,<base-lb>/PUSH H/LHLD idx/POP D/DAD D; LB-0 form LHLD idx/LXI D,*D(base)/DAD D); stride 3 replaces the 2-byte doubling with LXI DE,<stride> / CALL ?IM22N inside the same ladder; 1-byte reads sign-extend through MOV L,A/ADD A/SBB A/MOV H,A; byte stores are MVI A,v/STA at offset 0 and LXI H,*D/MVI M,v elsewhere, constant and computed; char(3) elements ride the scalar SMCCM (store len<cap) and SLCTS/PNCOP (PUT item) laws on the ELEMENT address, and the pool literal precedes the array in DATA.
column13: [E2E-53/P2] Armed forms ONLY as measured: strides outside {1,2,3}, stride-3 with lb=0, a subscript carrying an additive element term, literal byte stores outside 0<=v<=127, computed or self-update stores at element size != 2, array elements as CALL actuals with width != 2, char(1) elements, entry/label-value arrays and STATIC/varying descriptor arrays stay refused BY NAME (my-gap; DR acceptance UNMEASURED).
